title: MILLSTONE: How Open-Minded Are LLMs?
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the change in a Large Language Model's stance on controversial issues when presented with in-context arguments. One of the controversial issues included was related to the World Trade Center Muslim Center ("wtc-muslim-center"), measuring the model's stance and refusal rate on this topic.
findings: The paper finds that some models, specifically Claude Opus 4, frequently refuse to take a stance on controversial topics, including the religiously-contextualized issue of the "wtc-muslim-center". However, this refusal behavior vanishes when the model is presented with balanced arguments for and against the issue, causing the model to adopt a clear stance.
